# A clause table under headers of its own invention

`Policy: pol-HEAD` `DRAFT`

## Purpose

A table, and rows that read as clauses, under column names nothing agrees on. The columns are positional — the id
is read from the first and the obligation from the second — so a table headed otherwise is one being read by
position and not by name.

## Scope

This fixture only. It exists so `clause-table` is exercised on its header branch.

## Clauses

| Ref     | Obligation                                       |
|---------|--------------------------------------------------|
| `CLEAN` | **MUST** trigger `clause-table` and nothing else |
